body.objective: Students will be able to describe my school.
successCriteria: I can describe my school, subjects and schedule
I can make comparisons with 比 bǐ
I can use 更 gèng, 一样 yíyàng and 没有 méiyǒu in comparisons
body.hook: In English we say "taller than," "more interesting than." Mandarin uses one small word for all comparisons: 比 bǐ. Learn its pattern and you can compare schools, subjects, cities and friends.

study.title: 我的学校 Wǒ de xuéxiào
study.question: How do I describe and compare school life in Mandarin?
study.passage:
Subjects: 数学 shùxué (math), 科学 kēxué (science), 英语 Yīngyǔ (English), 中文 Zhōngwén (Chinese), 历史 lìshǐ (history), 体育 tǐyù (PE), 美术 měishù (art), 音乐 yīnyuè (music).
Comparison patterns:
• A 比 B + adjective: 数学比历史难。Shùxué bǐ lìshǐ nán. = Math is harder than history. (No 很 hěn before the adjective!)
• A 比 B 更 + adjective: 科学比数学更有意思。Kēxué bǐ shùxué gèng yǒu yìsi. = Science is even more interesting than math.
• A 没有 B + adjective: 美术没有数学难。Měishù méiyǒu shùxué nán. = Art is not as hard as math.
• A 跟 B 一样 + adjective: 我的学校跟你的学校一样大。Wǒ de xuéxiào gēn nǐ de xuéxiào yíyàng dà. = My school is as big as yours.
对话 Duìhuà:
安娜 Ānnà：你最喜欢什么科目？Nǐ zuì xǐhuan shénme kēmù?
大卫 Dàwèi：我最喜欢体育。体育比数学有意思！Wǒ zuì xǐhuan tǐyù. Tǐyù bǐ shùxué yǒu yìsi!
安娜：我觉得中文比英语难，可是中文更有意思。Wǒ juéde Zhōngwén bǐ Yīngyǔ nán, kěshì Zhōngwén gèng yǒu yìsi.
大卫：我们学校的作业很多。Wǒmen xuéxiào de zuòyè hěn duō.
安娜：我们学校的作业没有你们学校多。Wǒmen xuéxiào de zuòyè méiyǒu nǐmen xuéxiào duō.
Task: Compare four subjects and two schools using all four patterns.
study.source: Original dialogue written for this lesson.

study.product: Write and present eight sentences comparing your subjects, schedule and school with a partner's or a school in China, using 比, 更, 没有 and 一样.

examples.title: 比
examples.answer: 科学比美术难。Kēxué bǐ měishù nán.

examples.title: 更
examples.problem: Say "Music is even more interesting than history."
examples.answer: 音乐比历史更有意思。Yīnyuè bǐ lìshǐ gèng yǒu yìsi.

examples.title: 没有
examples.problem: Say "PE is not as hard as math."
examples.answer: 体育没有数学难。Tǐyù méiyǒu shùxué nán.
examples.explore: How is it different from 体育不难?

examples.title: 一样
examples.problem: Say "My homework is the same as yours."
examples.answer: 我的作业跟你的作业一样。Wǒ de zuòyè gēn nǐ de zuòyè yíyàng.

Name four school subjects in Mandarin.

items.q: 没有 in a comparison means

options: A) 科学更比数学有意思。
B) 科学有意思比数学。
C) 科学比数学更有意思。
D) 科学比数学很有意思。
items.answer: C) 科学比数学更有意思。

items.q: 我们学校的作业没有你们学校多 means
options: A) Your school has less homework
B) Our school has less homework than yours
C) Both schools have no homework
D) Our school has more homework
items.answer: B) Our school has less homework than yours

items.q: Why is 很 not used in 比 sentences?
options: A) The comparison already shows degree
items.answer: A) The comparison already shows degree

items.answer: Chinese is harder than English but more interesting.

items.answer: 比; 比 + 更; 没有; 跟 ... 一样.
